exact_audit_lemmas.coordinate_witness_leakage: If H=(a^2+b^2)(a^2-ab+b^2) and both factors are nontrivial, input (a,b) already factors H by two polynomial-time evaluations.
exact_audit_lemmas.idempotent_factor_split_equivalence: If e^2=e mod H then A=gcd(e,H), B=gcd(e-1,H) are coprime and AB=H. Conversely every coprime split H=AB defines by CRT e=0 mod A, e=1 mod B.
exact_audit_lemmas.uniform_polynomial_probe_support: For H=pq and polynomial P with r_p,r_q roots modulo p,q, uniform x mod H yields nontrivial gcd on exactly r_p(q-r_q)+r_q(p-r_p) residues, probability r_p/p+r_q/q-2*r_p*r_q/(pq). If deg P=d and P is nonzero modulo both primes, this is <=d/p+d/q.
exact_audit_lemmas.balanced_semiprime_cost: For p,q>=alpha*sqrt(H), a fixed-degree polynomial gcd probe has success O(H^-1/2) and independent-seed expected count Omega(sqrt(H))=2^Omega(n).
